_comment: Single source of truth for host SSH targets, IPs, and per-host desktop/config-file facts. Read by the host-touching skills (ssh-host, journal, nix-repl, fleet-status, fleet-rollout, verify-service) AND the package/DE skills (add-package, add-flatpak, switch-de, new-module) instead of each re-typing a copy. Desktop hosts (HM, Flatpak, swappable DE) have `desktop: true`; `envFile` is the host's system-config file. `ip` is the LAN address (DHCP, can drift); `tailscaleIp` is the Tailscale mesh address (100.x.y.z, stable per-device, added 2026-08-18 for all 5 devices — pi-hole/famdash's ssh.nix aliases route over this one specifically since their LAN IPs kept drifting). `aliases` (optional) lists extra short names `.claude/lib/resolve-host.sh` accepts for that host (e.g. `natalie` → natalie-laptop); an alias must not repeat across hosts or match a host key (`.claude/lib/check-hosts-json.sh` checks both). Update HERE only.

pi-hole.fleetExclude: Household DNS appliance: a fleet reboot or switch takes DNS down for the whole tailnet and every NixOS host. Update it on its own with deploy-pi-host, in a window the user picks.
pi-hole.notes: NixOS flake host since 2026-11-27 (Pi 4B, aarch64, 1 GB RAM, wired on end0): Pi-hole v6 with a local unbound, the household DNS appliance and the tailnet global nameserver. Image built on gaming and flashed, never rebuilt on-device; update it from gaming with deploy-pi-host (not fleet-rollout: see fleetExclude). The LAN address is static in NixOS (`ip` is authoritative) because the Xfinity gateway gives no admin access for a DHCP reservation or DHCP DNS, so devices reach Pi-hole through tailscaleIp: NixOS hosts point at it directly and other tailnet devices use the admin-console global nameserver. tailscaleIp is the single source for that nameserver, gaming's monitoring probes, the ssh.nix alias and every other host's DNS settings; the node kept it by copying the old tailscaled.state onto the new card. History: was .20 until an early-Aug 2026 power outage caused DHCP re-lease drift; Raspberry Pi OS until the 2026-11-27 cutover (rollback image: ~/pi-backups/pi-hole/old-card.img.zst).

famdash.notes: NixOS flake host since 2026-11-26 (Pi 4B, aarch64, headless, Wi-Fi only). Flashed from an SD image built on gaming; update it from gaming (nixos-rebuild --target-host), never build on-device. Boots from its SD card (EEPROM BOOT_ORDER=0xf41: SD, then USB). `ssh` is bosko@famdash: the host pins SSH AllowUsers to bosko, and ssh.nix derives the alias user from this field. Its tailnet name/IP was kept by copying the old Pi OS node's tailscaled.state onto the new card. History: family dashboard Pi at 10.0.0.20 (was .21 until an early-Aug 2026 power outage caused DHCP re-lease drift; landed on pi-hole's old address). 2026-08-18: joined the Tailscale mesh and ssh.nix's `famdash` alias dials the stable tailscaleIp instead of the LAN ip, so future DHCP drift no longer breaks the alias. `ip` (LAN) kept for reference only. (Pi OS era only: natty@ key trust was manual; the NixOS host takes its keys from the flake.) No router-side DHCP reservation yet (Xfinity gateway).
